# PlateScreen → Stride Sync Report — 2026-09-06

**This is a REPORTING task.** Nothing under `C:\stride-app` has been modified. All snippets below target `SG_RESTAURANTS` in `app/src/lib/sgFoodDb.ts` and are for a human to paste in after review.

## Summary

**1517 candidate brands** found (**1760 menu items total**), none ready to apply without review — every item is `confidence: 'estimated'` (`source: 'ai_estimate'`).

| Outlet type | Candidates | Menu items |
|---|---|---|
| Restaurants (`restaurant`) | 5 | 27 |
| Grab & Go (`grab_go`) | 3 | 23 |
| Food Court Stalls (`food_court_stall`) | 963 | 1130 |
| Hawker Stalls (`hawker`) | 546 | 580 |

### Why this run is unusually large

The last sync report was `2026-08-23.md` (7 candidates). Since then this sync task has not run for roughly two weeks, and on 2026-08-24 PlateScreen ran a large one-day "zero-menu backfill" sweep — dozens of sessions named `2026-08-24-zero-menu-<venue>-batch-<letter>.md` — that added a single AI-estimated menu item to most previously-bare hawker/food-court-stall/coffeeshop brands across the database (see `reference/research-sessions/` for that date). That batch, combined with the sync gap, is why this report has 1517 candidates instead of the usual handful. Every one of them is a single- or few-item, unverified estimate — none is HPB/official-sourced, so none qualifies for "Ready to Apply." Given the volume and uniformly low confidence, you may want to spot-check a sample rather than review all 1517 individually before applying.

### Out of scope this run: GroceryProduct table

`database/lib/groceryProducts.ts` (i.e. `src/lib/groceryProducts.ts`) now has 19 rows (FairPrice staples + 2 Bengawan Solo items) — the first-ever rows in that table, populated since the last sync. PlateScreen's `exportToStride.ts` has no mapping function for `GroceryProduct` (only `exportBrandToStride`/`exportAllToStride`, which operate on Brand/Premises/MenuItem), and Stride's `SGRestaurant`/`SGMenuItem` shape has no packaged-SKU concept (per-100g/per-package macros, no fixed serving) — same gap already flagged in the 2026-08-23 report for Bengawan Solo's 2 items. Not converted or included below; flagging for a human decision on whether/where this belongs in Stride (a new grocery table, or extending `SG_INGREDIENTS`).

### Ready to Apply

None this run — every candidate item is `confidence: 'estimated'` / `source: 'ai_estimate'`.

### Needs Admin Approval

All 1517 candidates below need admin review before going live (mirrors Stride's existing review gate for `ai_estimate` items). Grouped by outlet type; hawker/food-court-stall entries are further grouped by `hawkerLocation` (parent venue) where known. Where a specific PlateScreen research session could be matched (by filename), it's cited under each entry; entries from the 2026-08-24 bulk batch sweep are cited to their batch file where the venue could be matched, otherwise noted as "bulk zero-menu backfill, exact batch file not individually confirmed."
